name: Riverlands
notes: Open-world starter region. Players arrive by boat in the south-west and push north toward the ruined keep. Keep sight lines long across the plains; the forest is the only dense cover. Three-lane feel: river valley, king's road, forest ridge.

gameplay.description: Spawns, objectives, combat zones, points of interest

note.description: Comments, questions and open design issues

features.name: Eastern Woods
features.notes: Dense old-growth forest. Low visibility, winding animal trails, ambush territory.

features.name: North Ridge
features.notes: Steep ridge, ~60 m above the plains. Only climbable at the switchback path.

features.name: Oakford
features.notes: Riverside market town, the main hub. Stone bridge in the centre, timber houses around a square.

features.name: Silver River
features.notes: Comes down from the ridge, slow and wide by the time it reaches Oakford. Fordable only at the shallows.

features.name: King's Road
features.notes: Main paved road linking the harbour to the keep; crosses the river on the Oakford bridge.

features.name: Ruined Keep
features.notes: Final objective. Sits on the ridge overlooking the whole region.

features.name: Harbour Landing
features.notes: Player start. Small jetty and a lighthouse.

features.name: Where are the shallows?
features.notes: Should the ford be north or south of Oakford? North makes the woods more relevant.
